scanner.tipsHint: Shows tips for a clear scan
scanner.tipsBody:
• Put the document on a dark, flat surface.
• Use good light, or turn on Flash, and avoid shadows on the page.
• Hold the phone straight above the document until the blue outline settles.
• In Auto Capture the photo is taken by itself. You can fix the corners and pick a filter before saving.

log_out.title: Log out of Bharatfill?
log_out.bodyEmpty: To sign in again on this phone, you will need your mobile number and your Vault PIN.
log_out.bodySyncedOne:
Your document on this phone is also in your cloud vault. Remove it from this phone if other people use it.

Kept documents can be opened by anyone who uses this phone.
log_out.bodySyncedOther:
All {count} documents on this phone are also in your cloud vault. Remove them from this phone if other people use it.

Kept documents can be opened by anyone who uses this phone.
log_out.bodyAtRiskOne:
1 document is only on this phone and is not in your cloud vault. Removing it deletes it for good.

Kept documents can be opened by anyone who uses this phone.
log_out.bodyAtRiskOther:
{lost} documents are only on this phone and are not in your cloud vault. Removing them deletes them for good.

Kept documents can be opened by anyone who uses this phone.
log_out.doneBody: To sign in again, use your mobile number and your Vault PIN.
